studies.title: Mossel Bay
studies.caption: A spreading milkwood overlooks the sheltered curve of the bay, where a caravel lies at anchor beyond the rocky shore.
studies.prompt: Low sheltered-shore view of Mossel Bay around 1497: broad curving bay, ochre rock shelves, pale sand and fynbos hills, with a mature milkwood tree in the foreground, Khoekhoe cattle and tiny figures, and a small Portuguese caravel at anchor.
